headline: PM Tareque Rahman on first visit to Barishal since taking office
summary: Prime Minister Tareque Rahman embarked on his first visit to Barishal since becoming premier, with a day-long schedule including tree plantation programs and a meeting with party leaders.
details: Prime Minister Tareque Rahman is making his first visit to Barishal since assuming office. He departed from his Gulshan residence by road shortly after 6 AM on Monday, July 13.

The Prime Minister's itinerary includes several tree plantation programs. These are scheduled at the newly excavated Shorikol Canal in Gournadi's Batajore Union, at the Trish Godown Killing Field area, and near Trish Godown in Sagordi.

In the afternoon, Prime Minister Rahman will participate in an exchange of views meeting. This event will bring together leaders of the BNP and its associate organizations at the District Shilpakala Academy.
Prime Minister's Additional Press Secretary Atiqur Rahman Rumon stated that the Prime Minister is expected to return to Dhaka in the evening after completing all his scheduled programs for the day.
caption:
Prime Minister Tareque Rahman is on his first official visit to Barishal since assuming office, embarking on a day-long tour of the district.

Prime Minister Tareque Rahman is making his first visit to Barishal since assuming office. He departed from his Gulshan residence by road shortly after 6 AM on Monday, July 13.

The Prime Minister's itinerary includes several tree plantation programs. These are scheduled at the newly excavated Shorikol Canal in Gournadi's Batajore Union, at the Trish Godown Killing Field area, and near Trish Godown in Sagordi.

In the afternoon, Prime Minister Rahman will participate in an exchange of views meeting. This event will bring together leaders of the BNP and its associate organizations at the District Shilpakala Academy.

Prime Minister's Additional Press Secretary Atiqur Rahman Rumon stated that the Prime Minister is expected to return to Dhaka in the evening after completing all his scheduled programs for the day.

headline: SI withdrawn after immoral relationship with expatriate's wife during investigation
summary: A Sub-Inspector has been withdrawn from duty following allegations of an immoral relationship with the wife of an expatriate during an investigation. This incident has led to an internal inquiry within the police force.
details: A Sub-Inspector (SI) has been officially withdrawn from his duties following serious allegations of engaging in an immoral relationship. The incident reportedly occurred while the officer was conducting an investigation involving the family of a Bangladeshi expatriate.

The decision to withdraw the SI was made after the allegations surfaced, prompting an immediate internal inquiry. Authorities are now looking into the full circumstances surrounding the alleged misconduct.

This incident highlights concerns regarding professional conduct within the police force and underscores the importance of maintaining public trust. Further actions will be taken based on the findings of the ongoing investigation.
